Workspace scaffolded and the four articles added. Next step is picking models for the roles. The host offers the Agent aliases `haiku`, `sonnet`, `opus` and `fable`. `dragonhoard.json` has no models set yet, and with no journey history there's no evidence to tune against.

My suggestion:

| Role | Model | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| scout | `haiku` | Cheapest and fastest, and reliable with tools. Many scouts run per task and they only fetch facts, so reasoning depth matters little. |
| spiker | `sonnet` | Solid at coding and running tests for a mid-range cost. Up to 3 run in parallel per open choice, and this plan has 4 open choices. |
| judge | `opus` | Strongest reasoning model I can vouch for. It runs rarely (comparing options, reviewing lessons), so cost matters least. |

On `fable`: the host's model list puts Fable 5.1 above Opus, but I don't have solid information on how its reasoning compares. If you know it's stronger, use it for the judge. The host's own list beats my knowledge, which may be out of date.

Confirm `scout=haiku spiker=sonnet judge=opus`, or edit it. I won't save anything until you confirm.
